the fusion protein hspE7, which is composed of the heat shock protein 65 of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and the human papillomaviruses type 16 E6 protein, is a potent immunotherapy for human papillomaviral‐induced dysplasia and cancers of the cervix and anal canal.
